meta.title: Unclassified failure retry
meta.description: Makes DSH's unclassified model failure (PI_AI_ERROR) retryable by reporting it to the route's retry policy as RATE_LIMIT, so the step is resent instead of ending the turn on its first attempt. PI_AI_ERROR is what the adapter emits for a failure it cannot classify; recognised kinds (auth, quota, invalid request, context overflow, transport) already have their own codes and are untouched. The upstream sentence still reaches you, and the budget is the route's own (PackyCode: 20 attempts). Gateway refusals a resend cannot clear stay terminal: an official-client-only channel, a key whose groups do not cover the model, and a probe refusal; set guard: false to retry those too. Each retry is another billed request.
